summary.name: Bitcoin Core
summary.one_liner: Bitcoin Core is the reference software project for the Bitcoin network, and this page lists its recent release and security announcements.
use_cases: Download and run a Bitcoin full node
Check the latest Bitcoin Core release version
Read security advisories for Bitcoin Core
Operate a node on the Bitcoin peer-to-peer network
summary.what_it_does: The page announces Bitcoin Core releases 29.5, 30.4 and 31.2, all dated October 28, 2026. It also lists security notes about the software. One fix concerns announcements being queued for paused peers, which could grow the queue without limit. Another concerns a memory exhaustion risk from TCP urgent data on platforms other than Linux. The page text does not describe features, installation steps or system requirements.
notable: Reference implementation of the Bitcoin network node software
Discloses security issues in its release announcements
caveats: Page text covers only release and security notices; no feature details are given
A memory exhaustion issue affecting platforms other than Linux is described in the notices
